kindHint.per_team: Each team gets its own invitation. Everyone you pick can accept.
kindHint.fcfs: Ask more teams than you have places for. The ones who accept first take them.
kindHint.bulk: A single open invitation. Any team you tell about it can take a place while they last.
kindHint.per_player: Each player gets their own invitation. Everyone you pick can accept.
kindHint.fcfs_solo: Ask more players than you have places for. The ones who accept first take them.

organizer.title: Team invitations
organizer.description: Invite teams to this event instead of adding them yourself. They accept or decline, and accepting registers them through the normal registration checks.
organizer.dialogDescription: Pick the teams you want in this event. Each one gets a notification and can accept or decline.
organizer.messagePlaceholder: Add a note the team will see, for example why you want them in this event.
organizer.messageRemaining: {remaining, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}
organizer.toastTeamsFailed: Could not load the team list.
organizer.empty: No teams have been invited to this event yet.
organizer.emptyRowsWithCampaign: No team has answered yet. A general invitation has no per-team rows until somebody accepts it.
organizer.slotsPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the event's own capacity
organizer.slotsHint: How many of these teams may get in. Leave it empty and the event's own remaining capacity is the only limit.
organizer.deliveryHint: Everyone who can answer for the team gets it: the owner, captain, vice-captain, manager and coach.
organizer.deliveryWhatsappHint: WhatsApp only reaches people who switched it on in their profile. Keep email ticked as well.
organizer.reachRecipients: {people} people can answer for the {teams} team(s) you picked.
organizer.deliveryNoneSelected: Pick at least one place to send it.
organizer.toastDelivered: Reached {recipients} people: {pushed} in-app, {emailed} by email, {whatsapp} on WhatsApp.
organizer.noPlayersPicked: No players picked yet. Search for a name above.

team.title: Event invitations
team.description: Organizers who want your team in their event ask here. Accepting registers your team.
team.cannotRespond: Only the team owner, captain, vice-captain, manager, or coach can answer an invitation.
team.registrationClosed: Registration for this event is closed, so this invitation can no longer be accepted.
team.alreadyRegistered: Your team is already registered for this event.
team.acceptDescription: Choose the players who will represent {team}. Accepting registers your team, so every normal registration rule still applies.
team.rosterHintSquad: Pick 4 to 6 players. Coaches, managers and analysts cannot be put on an event roster.
team.noPlayers: This team has no players who can be rostered yet.
team.acceptBlockedHint: Nothing was accepted. Fix the problem above, or finish the entry on the event page, then try again.
team.declineDescription: The organizer is told you said no. A reason is optional and helps them offer the slot to somebody else.
team.reasonPlaceholder: For example: it clashes with another tournament.
team.fcfsNotice: First come, first served. More teams were asked than there are places, so the ones who accept first take them.
team.bulkNotice: An open invitation. Take a place while they last.
team.blockedAction: Then press Back to roster and try again.

event.bannerTitleTeam: {team} has been invited to this event
event.bannerTitleSolo: You have been invited to this event
event.bannerNote: Accepting opens the normal registration flow, so every registration rule still applies.
